model.scope: Macaque upper limb research geometry and modeled parameters; not full animal, raw scan certification, muscle volume, skin/fat geometry or living physics.
unknowns: original specimen/mesh ancestry; source XML credits are placeholders
layer thickness and tissue surface geometry
force law implementation and physiological validation

assumptions: Root and five source coordinates fixed; only source shoulder flexion and elbow flexion move.
Effective segment masses/inertias retained; this is not isolated bone material.
RK4 reference at four substeps per 300 Hz tick; trajectory convergence and bounded energy error must be measured separately.
Joint limits are perfectly inelastic unilateral stops with coupled-mass reaction impulses; no arbitrary pose clipping.

Optional frictionless unilateral hand contact with an authored rigid plane at contact_plane_height_m in the local East/Up/South world frame (metres). Signed gap g = hand point Up coordinate + proxy_radius_m - contact_plane_height_m; free motion keeps g >= 0.

Optional authored Coulomb friction at the same plane: contact_friction in [0,1] (default 0 = the qualified frictionless contact, bit-exact control). Stick solves the normal and tangential accelerations jointly in the mass metric; slide caps the tangential reaction at mu times the normal reaction and re-solves the normal row with the exact cross-coupling. Heat enters the ledger as friction_heat_J. Grasping remains unimplemented; friction never pulls without normal load.

contact_enabled is false by default; toggling it requires an explicit reset, and the disabled mode must reproduce the qualified free coupled dynamics. Enabled scenes must start with a strictly positive gap at the reset pose.
Ideal capped actuator work consumes finite mechanical energy; braking produces heat. Isometric metabolic/electrical costs and biological muscles absent.
CPU reference reuses native source binding and Earth field; GPU residency and full animal unqualified.
